purpose: Mine machine-level invariants shared by residual 3CNF instances after exact polynomial preprocessing, without treating any finite sample invariant as a universal theorem.
exactness: SAT-equivalence preserving; SAT witness lifting metadata required for eliminated variables.
machine_signature: every remaining variable has occurrence degree >= 2
every remaining variable occurs in both polarities
remaining clauses and variables form one or more incidence 2-core components
why_this_matters: This strips easy leaf/pure/unit structure before asking for a universal representation invariant. Any genuine arbitrary-3CNF residual solver must explain the surviving bipolar cyclic interaction core rather than repeatedly rediscovering removable fringe structure.
required_output: whether each frozen residual reaches the candidate machine
counterexample if a frozen residual does not
seal: REMOVE THE FRINGE, THEN STUDY THE MACHINE THAT REFUSES TO FALL OFF.
